purpose: Recover independently evidenced historical knowledge times and rematerialize a nonempty point-in-time state and matrix without inventing source publication facts.

domain_tiers.TEAM_OUTCOME_CONTEXT: May admit reliable games, schedules, official outcomes, teams, rankings, and venues for Elo, team-strength priors, outcome modeling, and long-run program context.
domain_tiers.EVENT_DETAIL: Drives, plays, gamebook-equivalent facts, team/player box scores, and advanced game statistics require domain-specific evidence and may remain partial independently.
domain_tiers.ROSTER_AVAILABILITY: Rosters, starters, injuries, depth charts, practice, and availability require evidence for identity, effective time, and historical knowledge time; no name-only merge is permitted.
domain_tiers.WEATHER_MARKET_CONTEXT: Weather, market, and other context require source-specific forecast/vintage or archived evidence appropriate to the prediction cutoff.

execution_phases.required_output: Content-addressed inventory of all quarantined candidates grouped by every eligibility dimension and evidence route.
Immutable external captures with source URL, acquisition time, content hash, version identity, and route-specific historical-time evidence.
Deterministic candidate-to-evidence joins, conflict findings, abstentions, schema drift, and domain-scoped quarantine.
New content-addressed BAT-395 through BAT-398 candidate artifacts with deterministic rebuild and chronological replay.
Explicit matrix approval or block decision; file creation and row count alone cannot pass.

acceptance_criteria: Every admitted row has source-record evidence, immutable capture identity, and a defensible historical known-at timestamp.
At least one real game and prediction cutoff can be chronologically replayed without target-game outcome or future-state leakage.
The accepted state and matrix are nonempty, content-addressed, deterministic, and independently validated.
Partial or failed domains remain explicit and do not silently inherit eligibility from another domain.
All negative findings, provider limitations, schema drift, missingness, conflicts, and quarantined records are preserved.
BAT-398 is re-executed and explicitly approves the new matrix before BAT-399 becomes eligible.
